activeSession.task: Redesigned the Traductions module (M6) end-to-end: Phase 1 audit → Phase 2 plan → backend (aggregates, vue=supprimees, source filter) → frontend (queue + workshop). Found and fixed two real bugs during the audit/build: (1) documentId silently dropped between the OCR-prefill sessionStorage payload and the actual translation-launch call, so every document-originated translation lost its document link; (2) glossary suggestions always searched the translation's source-language column regardless of which panel (original vs translation) the user selected text in, so selecting the target-language draft — the natural thing to do while reviewing — never returned matches. Added PATCH /:id/relancer to retry the engine on a manuelle_requise translation without ever overwriting a manual draft. Per explicit user request: migrated the whole app from BrowserRouter to createBrowserRouter/RouterProvider to enable useBlocker for the workshop's unsaved-changes guard, and replaced all 6 window.confirm() call sites app-wide (not just Traductions) with a new useConfirm() dialog. Added npm run services:up/down/restart/logs/status wrapping docker compose for libretranslate/translate-service/ocr-service. Mid-session the user flagged that the queue's filter bar and table didn't match the Missions/Courriers convention and had a visible header-hover bug — traced to the shared DataTable component (dark navy header + TableRow's hover class applying to header rows too); rebuilt the queue with a hand-built TraductionsRegistryTable/MobileCards and a MissionsFilters-shaped TraductionsFiltres (debounced search, Select+chips, Plus de filtres), adding real server-side search in the process. Investigated the Glossaire module's actual workflow at the user's request (manual add + auto-enrichment from translation corrections) and confirmed a CSV import endpoint already exists server-side with no client UI yet.
activeSession.nextAction: Flag the document-based glossary auto-extraction recommendation in the Notion backlog (user explicitly asked, not yet done), then commit and push this session's Traductions redesign work.
